title: Battle of Rovers
fullDescription: Battle of Rovers is a compelling multiplayer third-person shooter centered around engaging rover combat. Developed with remarkable efficiency and a high degree of polish, the game leverages extensive AI integration in both programming and development. Players have enthusiastically embraced the gameplay experience. As the lead developer on this project, I leveraged AI as a powerful assistant, building upon an existing Fusion Photon asset and significantly enhancing it to create this engaging experience. I also managed and mentored a team of artists who provided the game's art assets. Battle of Rovers exists in two distinct versions: one with cryptocurrency integration and another for Steam, with the project automatically switching between them using CICD pipelines and custom editor tools. For user management, Unity Services were implemented, and AWS Lambda functions handle various backend functionalities. The Steam version features a robust inventory and shop system, alongside extensive rover customization options. Multiplayer functionality for both versions is powered by Photon Fusion. Furthermore, the cryptocurrency version includes its own custom launcher and updater, and the game integrates the Tournament SDK for competitive play.
role: Solo Developer (with AI Assistance) & Art Team Manager

process.title: Core Gameplay Development with AI Assistance
process.description: Leveraged AI extensively for programming and rapidly developed the core third-person shooter mechanics using an asset from Fusion Photon as a base.

process.title: Multiplayer Implementation with Photon Fusion
process.description: Integrated and configured Photon Fusion to create a robust and scalable multiplayer experience for up to 200 concurrent users.

process.title: Art Asset Management and Integration
process.description: Managed and mentored a team of artists to create and integrate high-quality art assets for the game environment, rovers, and effects.

process.title: Steam Version Features: Inventory, Shop & Customization
process.description: Implemented a comprehensive inventory and shop system for the Steam version, allowing players to acquire and manage various rover customizations.

process.title: Crypto Version with Crypto Transfer & Custom Launcher
process.description: Developed a dedicated crypto version of the game featuring cryptocurrency transfer functionalities and a custom launcher and updater for seamless access.

process.title: Tournament Integration & Competitive Play
process.description: Integrated the Tournament SDK to enable competitive gameplay and tournament management within both the crypto and Steam versions.

process.title: Backend Services with Unity Services & AWS Lambda
process.description: Utilized Unity Services for user management and implemented AWS Lambda functions to handle various backend needs, ensuring a robust and scalable infrastructure.

process.title: Automated Version Switching with CICD & Editor Tools
process.description: Set up CICD pipelines and developed custom editor tools to automate the process of switching between the crypto and Steam versions of the game.
